newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies four bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies four bond issues for insurance.

text.p: FGIC said Monday it qualified for insurance four bond issues slated for for competitive sale on Monday.
--Hartland District, Mich., $19 million of school district bonds.
--Greenville Area School District, Pa., $8 million of GO bonds under the alternate bidding program.
--West Perry School District, Pa., $6 million of GO bonds under the alternate bidding program.
--Mesquite, Texas, $5.140 million and $1.4 million of GOs.
